description: Appa Kuttige Karolis Perera v. Appa Kuttige Simion Perera and Two Others Appa Kuttige Karolis Perera v. Appa Kuttige Simion Perera and Two Others View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: Appa Kuttige Karolis Perera v. Appa Kuttige Simion Perera and Two Others Appa Kuttige Karolis Perera v. Appa Kuttige Simion Perera and Two Others View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s decision dissolving the decree nisi and dismissing his testamentary action seeking probate of the alleged Last Will; preliminary objection on maintainability in terms of Section 754(2) of Civil Procedure Code rejected. Held - serious doubts concerning the signature, the Notary’s seal, the identity of an attesting witness, and conflicting evidence on execution. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
